considerations.what: Consider whether self-defence or first-contact issues arise on instructions and the evidence sequence.
considerations.why: Violence / public-order allegations often turn on who used force first and whether any response was reasonable — but that is not established merely because the charge is Affray or assault.
mustConfirm: Client instructions on belief in need to use force
Source-backed sequence / first contact evidence
Any served CCTV/BWV/witness account supporting the defence narrative

considerations.what: The CAD / listing timing reference may justify checking whether related call or control-room material exists or is relevant.

Schedule or MG6 entry for 999 / control-room product

considerations.what: Consider whether BWV exists or requires checking where arrest / officer / violence circumstances make that a sensible investigative question.

mustConfirm: Source mention of BWV / body-worn product

considerations.what: Consider whether medical or injury evidence is relevant to harm / causation once instructions and papers are reviewed.

mustConfirm: Source mention of medical / injury product

considerations.what: Consider separating interview summary vs full recording vs transcript service issues before any court or chase wording.
considerations.why: Interview modality splits are high-risk for false 'missing' claims; each product must be tracked independently.

considerations.what: Consider distinguishing CCTV stills/clips from master footage / export log before asserting continuity or completeness.

considerations.what: Consider PACE / custody safeguard attack paths where custody or interview process material is in the papers.

considerations.what: Consider sequence, participation, and whether the Crown can prove the statutory fear-of-violence element from served accounts/CCTV.

considerations.what: Defer final strategy. Issue a single consolidated disclosure request covering every outstanding item, with a stated deadline. Set a calendar review for the day after the deadline.

considerations.what: Consider whether possession is personal use versus supply inference, and what packaging/weight/phone evidence actually proves.
considerations.why: Drugs strategies often turn on supply inference — must not invent phone downloads from offence alone.
mustConfirm: Source-backed element evidence before asserting the defence as case theory

considerations.what: Consider attribution: screenshots vs full download / subscriber mapping before any definitive attribution wording.
considerations.why: Digital matters collapse when attribution is overstated from screenshots alone.
mustConfirm: Source-backed element evidence before asserting the defence as case theory

considerations.what: Defer final strategy. Issue a single consolidated disclosure request covering every outstanding item, with a stated deadline. Set a calendar review for the day after the deadline.
considerations.why: Committing to a defence narrative the bundle cannot yet support is one of the highest-risk things a defence team can do.
mustConfirm: Final defence position cannot be set without the missing material; nothing about its content is assumed.
Higher-confidence structured evidence before factual court wording

considerations.what: Issue a written disclosure request for a complete exhibit schedule, citing CPIA s.3 and the disclosure officer's continuing duty. Set a 14-day deadline and copy the prosecutor.
considerations.why: a complete exhibit schedule is material to a fair assessment. Without it, the defence cannot finalise position and the prosecution cannot demonstrate compliance with disclosure duties.
mustConfirm: Content of a complete exhibit schedule is unknown until served — no assumption is made about whether it helps or hurts the defence.
Higher-confidence structured evidence before factual court wording

considerations.what: Consider whether self-defence or first-contact issues arise on instructions and the evidence sequence.
considerations.why: Violence / public-order allegations often turn on who used force first and whether any response was reasonable — but that is not established merely because the charge is Affray or assault.
mustConfirm: Client instructions on belief in need to use force
Source-backed sequence / first contact evidence
Any served CCTV/BWV/witness account supporting the defence narrative

considerations.what: Consider whether BWV exists or requires checking where arrest / officer / violence circumstances make that a sensible investigative question.
considerations.why: Officer involvement often produces BWV, but offence shape alone must not create a 'BWV missing' fact or chase item.
mustConfirm: Source mention of BWV / body-worn product
Schedule entry for BWV

considerations.what: Consider whether medical or injury evidence is relevant to harm / causation once instructions and papers are reviewed.
considerations.why: Violence allegations often engage harm evidence, but that is a professional consideration until papers establish medical material.
mustConfirm: Source mention of medical / injury product

considerations.what: Consider distinguishing CCTV stills/clips from master footage / export log before asserting continuity or completeness.
considerations.why: Clip/master confusion is a known false-open class; stills do not prove master continuity.
mustConfirm: Explicit source language on master / export / continuity status
